verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own "sandbox mode" that lets you test transactional emails without sending them, which directly addresses part of the story. However, it behaves like a dry-run flag scoped to transactional email sends. Nothing shows a separate sandbox environment with isolated, non-production data. Missing for 10: a documented isolated sandbox or test environment separate from production account data, sandbox coverage beyond transactional email (contacts, campaigns, CRM, SMS), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test transactional emails without sending them using sandbox mode
